intent: REFACTOR ValidationStatus: inspect the implementation for layering violations, blocking calls, unbounded buffers, hardcoded values and invariant gaps; improve clarity without changing the public surface or breaking tests. Spec: Telemetry Intake & Validation domain enum ValidationStatus {UNVALIDATED, VALID, VALIDATION_FAILED}. UNVALIDATED is only the state of a freshly received sample; after validation a sample is always VALID or VALIDATION_FAILED, never dropped.
